nourished.screen.diet.tip: Try to keep your diet balanced by eating a variety of foods.
nourished.toast.critical.title: %s is critically low!
nourished.toast.critical.subtitle: Your %s nutrition needs attention.
nourished.tooltip.unclassified: Unclassified — no nutrient tag and no confident guess
nourished.tooltip.light_food: Can be eaten for nutrients when hunger is full (no hunger restore).
config.nourished.title: Nourished Config
config.nourished.preview.hudDisabled.des: The nutrition HUD is disabled. Enable HUD in Modules to preview live colors here.
config.nourished.presets.listLabel.desc: Switch between gameplay styles from config/nourished/presets. Built-in presets are created on first run if missing.
config.nourished.presets.delete.title: Delete preset
config.nourished.presets.delete.message: Remove preset "%s" from disk? This cannot be undone.
config.nourished.presets.saveDialog.name: Name
Display name.
config.nourished.hudColors.resetAll.tool: Clears every per-nutrient override in memory and refreshes the hex fields. Click Save to write config/nourished/colors.json.
config.nourished.hudColors.row.tooltip: Exactly seven characters: # plus six hex digits. While valid, the HUD preview updates in real time. Invalid input shows a red outline and blocks saving this screen.
config.nourished.colors.picker.desc: R/G/B sliders, hex field, and wheel stay in sync. Saves to config/nourished/colors.json. Datapack override: data/nourished/config/colors.json.
config.nourished.scanner.enableRecipeInh: Use recipe ingredient ancestry as an extra classification signal when scanning unassigned foods.
config.nourished.scanner.confidenceSprea: Minimum gap between top and second-best classification score to mark a result as confident.
config.nourished.foodScanner.title: Food scanner
config.nourished.foodScanner.desc: Find foods with no nutrient tag (same filter as /nourished get_unassigned_foods), then assign them and write a datapack for this world (singleplayer only).
config.nourished.foodScanner.emptyHint: Click Scan while in a world to list unassigned foods.
config.nourished.foodScanner.wroteToast: Written to %s — reload datapacks to apply
config.nourished.foodScanner.noWorld: No active world — open a singleplayer world first
config.nourished.compat.title: Compat Browser
config.nourished.compat.desc: Detected mods, built-in compat coverage, and per-mod compat settings in one place.
config.nourished.enableDecay.desc: Nutrients slowly drain over time when enabled.
config.nourished.enableNutritionEating.d: When hunger is full, eating can still grant nutrients without restoring hunger (nutrition-only eating). Optional Block Heavy Meals / Block Light Food toggles prevent tagged items from using this bypass.
nourished.config.blockHeavyMeals: Block heavy meals at full hunger
nourished.config.blockHeavyMeals.desc: When true, at full vanilla hunger blocks nutrition-only eating for nourished:meal items, or when Spice of Life: Onion is installed for foods whose vanilla nutrition is at or above Heavy meal nutrition threshold.
nourished.config.heavyMealNutritionThres: With Spice of Life: Onion, foods with FoodProperties nutrition at or above this value count as heavy meals for the block toggle. mod_compat.json can override this for solonion when that field is set.
nourished.config.blockLightFood: Block light food at full hunger
nourished.config.blockLightFood.desc: When true, items tagged nourished:light_food cannot be eaten at full vanilla hunger (including nutrition-only eating).
config.nourished.enableDebugLogging.desc: When enabled, writes detailed nutrition diagnostics to config/nourished/debug/
config.nourished.enableToasts.desc: Show pop-up notifications for nutrient events.
config.nourished.enableFoodTooltips.desc: Show nutrient information in food item tooltips.
config.nourished.enableDietScreen.desc: Enable the Diet screen from inventory or keybind.
config.nourished.enableCriticalToasts.de: Warn you when any nutrient drops into the critical zone.
config.nourished.enableSleepBonus.desc: Sleeping with all nutrient bars above 50% grants Regeneration I for 30 seconds.
config.nourished.enableRawFoodPenalty.de: When true, eating raw food applies potion effects and nutrient penalties based on severity
config.nourished.enableStamina.desc: When true, the dual physical/mental stamina bar system is active
config.nourished.enableSynergies.desc: When false, nutrient and food synergy checks are skipped
config.nourished.enableMilestones.desc: When false, milestone checks are skipped
config.nourished.enableSeasonHooks.desc: When false, season hook modifiers are ignored
config.nourished.enableAbsorptionModifie: When false, absorption modifier hooks are ignored
config.nourished.modules.bulk.desc: Apply module toggles in one click.
config.nourished.modules.profiles.desc: Apply a curated gameplay module setup.
config.nourished.modules.dependencyHint: Tip: Critical Toasts depends on Toasts being enabled.
config.nourished.reloadConfigs.desc: Reload all Nourished config files from disk.
config.nourished.reloadConfigs.chat: Reloaded Nourished datapack registries from disk.
config.nourished.effects.builder.desc: Each card edits one rule in config/nourished/effects.json. Save writes instantly.
config.nourished.defaultEffectDurationTi: Default duration in ticks for nutrition effects. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.nourished.effects.delete.title: Delete effect
config.nourished.effects.delete.message: Remove effect rule "%s" from the list? This takes effect after you confirm; use Save on other cards if you have unsaved edits.
config.nourished.startingNutrientValue.d: Fill level (0-100%) for every nutrient bar on new diet data (new players, fresh saves). Default 50% gives a neutral baseline; decay lowers it and food raises it.
config.nourished.nutrientGainScale.desc: Multiplier on tag-based food burst before the per-bite cap. Lower = slower bar fill (default 5). Does not affect food override JSON.
Largest fraction (0-100%) one bite can add to a single bar from tag-based foods (default 20%). Lower = more bites to fill a bar.
config.nourished.calorieDisplayMax.desc: Maximum calorie value shown in the UI.
config.nourished.decayRate.desc: How quickly nutrients drain each decay step.
config.nourished.decayIntervalTicks.desc: How often nutrient decay is applied (in ticks).
config.nourished.enableEffects.desc: Apply buffs and debuffs based on nutrient levels.
config.nourished.showFoodTooltips.desc: When enabled, edible items show a Nourished nutrition section in their tooltip.
config.nourished.enableHUD.desc: Show the nutrient HUD while playing.
config.nourished.hudAnchor.desc: Choose the screen corner used as the HUD anchor.
config.nourished.hudOffsetX.desc: Horizontal offset from the anchor corner (pixels).
config.nourished.hudOffsetY.desc: Vertical offset from the anchor corner (pixels).
config.nourished.hudBarWidth.desc: Set the width of each nutrient bar on the HUD.
config.nourished.hudScale.desc: Scale HUD bars, labels, and spacing together.
config.nourished.hudReservedBottom.desc: Reserve space above the hotbar for bottom anchors (pixels).
config.nourished.hudDraggable.desc: Let you drag the HUD panel in-game to reposition it.
config.nourished.dietBarDragEnabled.desc: Let you drag nutrient rows in the Diet screen.
config.nourished.hideZeroNutrients.desc: Hide HUD rows for nutrients currently at 0%.
config.nourished.criticalThreshold.desc: Nutrient level that counts as critical.
config.nourished.lowThreshold.desc: Nutrient level that counts as low.
config.nourished.excessThreshold.desc: Nutrient level that counts as excess.
config.nourished.bonusEffectThreshold.de: Minimum nutrient level needed for bonus effects.
Nutrient level where penalty effects can trigger.
config.nourished.hudEditHotkey.desc: Press this key in-game to enter HUD edit mode.
config.nourished.hud.quickActions.desc: Reset HUD layout and diet-bar arrangement without leaving this screen.
config.nourished.importExport.groupTitle: Bundle settings into a JSON file under config/nourished/exports/ or share a compact NCF1: code. Import applies selected sections and reloads JSON registries.
config.nourished.importExport.exportNoth: Select at least one section to export.
config.nourished.importExport.noExportFi: No JSON files in config/nourished/exports/ yet.
config.nourished.importExport.invalidCod: Could not read that share code.
config.nourished.importExport.invalidBun: That file has no recognized sections.
config.nourished.importExport.applyNothi: Select at least one section to import.
config.nourished.importExport.importSucc: Config imported successfully — some changes may require restart
config.nourished.compat.enableCodeCompat: Enables special code-level compatibility behaviour for this mod.
Enables tag-based food classification for items from this mod.
config.nourished.enableLSOBrokenHeartRes: High nutrition boosts LSO broken heart resilience
config.nourished.enableLSOThermalResista: Nutrition level affects LSO thermal resistance attribute
config.nourished.enableLSOThirstSaturati: Eating nutritious food adds a small LSO thirst saturation bonus
config.nourished.enablePSExhaustionDurat: Applies exhaustion_duration_multiplier attribute modifier based on nutrition level
config.nourished.enablePSPenaltyDecay.de: Applies penalty_decay_multiplier attribute modifier based on nutrition level
config.nourished.enablePSStaminaUsage.de: Applies stamina_usage attribute modifier based on nutrition level

Low dietary diversity applies a max health penalty via Spice of Life: Onion
